comparison.objective: Push two framing struts onto a snap connector while holding one still, then lift-test the joint; candidate adjusts and locks a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual stabilization, linear insertion, snap engagement, and lift verification versus hex-key use, fine collar rotation, and torque-limited relocking.
comparison.success_condition: Connector fully snapped, corner square, and assembly survives a lift; candidate requires repeated energy-absorption performance and drift resistance.
comparison.reason: Both stabilize a component and verify retention, but snap-fit assembly tests discrete insertion while the candidate tests iterative continuous tuning.
